question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/085e2299035677aa475ceddc807b65db19487ece0cb57ec18e625f230d2fcd97.png]
solution:
When a mirror is placed vertically to the object, the image so formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and** Right Hand Side** interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e095376ef4edcaec5da90fec7adad36301b9492a701a3ef2036ae920ce0a9500.png] 

Therefore, only option(2) shows the correct image.

Hence, the correct answer is **option(2).**
